description: Uva Province - Summoning the Uva Province Provincial Council to meet on 21.11.2016
categorisation: This gazette content is a proclamation by the Governor of Uva Province summoning the Provincial Council to meet. This falls under electoral and governance processes at the provincial level, specifically related to the convening of an elected legislative body (Provincial Council). It does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or detailed portfolio assignments that would classify it under Types 1-3, nor does it fit any other specialized category better than Elections (Type 7).
